stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard plan check [-h] [--file FILE] [--ask ASK]
                                    [--done-when DONE_WHEN] [--json]
                                    [--explain]
                                    [source]

positional arguments:
  source                owner/repo#N, an issue URL (a #issuecomment-ID picks
                        that comment), or N with intent_repo set; the plan is
                        the latest `Plan (scenarios)` comment, else the issue
                        body

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --file FILE           Read the plan from this file instead of GitHub
  --ask ASK             The ask whose Done-when to cover when the plan issue
                        has none of its own
  --done-when DONE_WHEN
                        The Done-when line to cover (overrides the issue's)
  --json                Machine-readable result
  --explain             After each defect (and warning) say the rule it breaks
                        and how to fix it
